meta.name: story-deslop
meta.description: 网文去AI味。检测并清除文本中的AI写作痕迹，让文字回归自然、非模板化。触发方式：/story-deslop、/去AI味、「去AI味」「这篇太AI了」「网文去AI味」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把生硬模板化的网文改写成自然顺口、有人味的文字
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你用AI起草网文,想让成品读起来像真人手笔。
copy.tagline_en: Rewrite stiff, templated web fiction into natural, human-sounding prose
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you draft web fiction with AI and want it to read like a human wrote it.

howto.what: 检测网文里的AI写作痕迹，比如模板句式、空转情绪句、对话标签堆砌，标出每处位置并给出AI味等级；你让它改时，它在保留剧情的前提下逐句改写，只动说法不动情节。
howto.when: 当你输入 /story-deslop、/去AI味，或提到「这篇太AI了」等说法时触发；说「检查下有没有AI味」就只出检测报告，不改原文。

say.text: 帮我看看这段有没有AI味
say.note: 只出检测报告和问题标记，不改原文

say.text: 这段太AI了，按中度标准去AI味
say.note: 按中度策略过对应 Gate 并出润色报告

say.text: 给这几个章节文件去AI味，改动控制住比例
say.note: 文件模式直接改稿落盘，只回片段

howto.what_en: Scans web fiction for AI writing traces — template patterns, empty emotion lines, stacked dialogue tags — marks each spot and rates the AI-flavor level. Asked to rewrite, it edits sentence by sentence while keeping plot and characters intact.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you run /story-deslop or /去AI味, or say things like "this reads too AI". If you only ask for a check, it returns a detection report and leaves the text unchanged.

say_en.text: Check this passage for AI flavor
say_en.note: Detection report and problem table only, no edits

say_en.text: This reads too AI — deslop it at medium level
say_en.note: Runs the matching gates and outputs a polish report

say_en.text: Deslop these chapter files, keep the cut ratio in range
say_en.note: File mode writes edits to disk, returns only excerpts
